summary.text: Brandon Shippy represents Idaho Senate District 9 and lives in New Plymouth; the Idaho Legislature's member page lists a second term and describes him as a small business owner.

paragraphs.text: The legislature biography describes Shippy as a lifelong Idahoan and native of the western Treasure Valley, and says Shippy is an active member of the Idaho Republican Party, serving as a precinct committeeman.
